id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_080.pack|cs_: "Sorry, Dad. Mum's necklace, your most precious thing, broke...
"How worried I was! Nothing is more precious than your life!
"...But Dad, you said Mum's necklace was your most precious thing.
"When that monster asked, I had a bad feeling and lied on the spot... to protect you.
"I thought you didn't care about me. I was so wrong. I'm sorry I worried you.
"Son never checked his father's true feelings and misunderstood. Talking would have settled it.
"You saved us twice, traveler. You are our hero. Thank you.
"Truth is, when you first saved me, I was searching for Son.
"But if monsters returned, they might take him. So I acted the opposite of what I felt.
"Huh? Where's the feather sister? I wanted to thank her...
"He left suddenly. What happened? {var:1}, let's find him."
